$comment: The one list of labels, openers and headings (scripts/labels.json, which scripts/labels.mjs reads and makes and scripts/inbox.mjs writes as two lines). Each rule's mend is what a failure of it says (scripts/schemas.mjs).
title: the list
mend: write the list as a JSON object with "_", its note, "state", "sender" and "mark", the labels, "openers", the lines an agent's comment opens with, and "headings", as {core}scripts/labels.json stands

mendFor.additionalProperties: take it out; the list holds "_", "state", "sender", "mark", "openers" and "headings" alone

labels.mend: write it as an object of labels, each named by its key, of at most 50 characters, as GitHub takes a name

propertyNames.mend: name the label by 1 to 50 characters with no space at either end, as GitHub takes a name

additionalProperties.mend: write the label as { "color": six lower-case hex digits, "description": at most 100 characters }, as GitHub takes one

mendFor.additionalProperties: take it out; a label holds "color" and "description" alone

color.mend: write the colour as six lower-case hex digits, with no #, as GitHub takes it

description.mend: write a description of 1 to 100 characters, as GitHub takes it

_.mend: write the note as one string

propertyNames.mend: name each sender label by:<who>, which inbox.mjs writes without its by:

openers.mend: write it as a list of the lines an agent's comment opens with, each a non-empty string with no colon and no space at either end

headings.mend: write it as { "word", "design", "view", "found", "current", "reasons" }, each a heading as a non-empty string

mendFor.additionalProperties: take it out; "headings" holds "word", "design", "view", "found", "current" and "reasons" alone
